title: Target naturality of module cohomology maps for an isomorphism
statement: Let X and Y be schemes, h : X -> Y, G an O_Y-module, F and F′ O_X-modules, phi : G -> h_*F, e : F ≅ F′ and p a natural number. The additive cohomology map moduleCohomologyFMap(h,phi,p), followed by H^p(X,e.hom), equals moduleCohomologyFMap(h,phi followed by h_*(e.hom),p). Cohomology and its h-map are those of [def-weil-pbc-module-cohomology-fmap].

source.place: Lemma 01F8 and Remark 01FB; resolution comparison using Derived Categories Tags 013P, 013S and 05TG

proof.text: Choose the data D and E defining the two canonical maps. Lift e.hom between their target resolutions and id_G between their source resolutions, respecting augmentations.

Extend by zero to integer indices. K-injectivity of E.K and the quasi-isomorphism D.lambda give t : D.K -> E.K making the lambda square homotopy commutative. Compatibility of beta and the augmentation equations then give the beta square by uniqueness up to homotopy after the quasi-isomorphic source augmentation.

Apply sections and homology to both homotopies. The canonical sections comparisons commute with the resolution lift by naturality of restrictions. Cancel the invertible vertical homology maps supplied by D and E, then transport through isoRightDerivedObj naturality for e.hom and id_G and the forgetful homology comparisons. Substituting the definition of map yields the claimed equality.

theorem moduleCohomologyFMap_target_iso_naturality {X Y : Scheme.{u}} (h : X ⟶ Y)
    {G : SheafOfModules.{u} Y.ringCatSheaf} {F F' : SheafOfModules.{u} X.ringCatSheaf}
    (φ : G ⟶ (pushforward h).obj F) (e : F ≅ F') (p : ℕ) :
    moduleCohomologyFMap h φ p ≫ (forget₂ _ AddCommGrpCat).map
      ((RingedSpace.moduleCohomology X.toRingedSpace p).map e.hom) =
      moduleCohomologyFMap h (φ ≫ (pushforward h).map e.hom) p
